address_comment_regular: [Verified] ActorProcessManager_SaveTempEffects walks active and extended effect lists, skips effects whose virtual IsSaveable returns false, writes each saveable effect's one-byte GetTypeID, then calls SaveGame and increments the count. Thus fallback decals may persist without a target reference, while generated-geometry decals require a valid target reference and 3D.
